name: Across Private Investments

entity_kind.quote: Slovakian firm Across Private Investments is the lead investor in this round.

investor_type.quote: The firm focuses on early-stage investments in app marketing, blockchain, and mobile advertising industries across Europe and Northern America.

investments.quote: The funding round was led by existing investors including Across Private Investments, LevelUp Ventures, Zero One Hundred, and Venture to Future Fund, along with new investor Strecko Investments.
Led by Venture to Future Fund, with participation from Across Private Investments and Zero One Hundred, this Series A round marks SuperScale’s first significant capital raise

notes: Across is primarily a Slovak wealth/asset manager (securities dealer licensed by NBS) that also makes direct private/venture investments for its clients; classified as investor with type vc as closest fit, but it is not a dedicated VC fund. AUM of 450+ mil. EUR covers the whole wealth management business, not a venture vehicle. No deals after Nov 2024 found; Tachyum/Brightpick appear only on aggregators. Manual check 2026-10-09: the 450M EUR figure is wealth-management client assets, not VC fund size; AUM removed.
